name: Leather Shield

features.text: Leather Shield repels moisture and prevents drying and cracking.
Restores and preserves the natural luster and softness of leather.
Long-lasting. non-greasy formula that contains mink oil and lanolin.
Can be used on new and old leather.

description: Leather Shield is a unique, lanolin-enriched, water-based lotion blended with natural moisturizers and fortified with mink oil to maintain the soft, pliable leather texture. Leather Shield replenishes oils, cleans surface dirt, protects against ultraviolet-light damage and helps preserve and return the supple feel, softness and natural luster of leather.
application: Pour Leather Shield onto a soft, clean cloth or sponge, and apply to leather in an overlapping, circular motion using medium pressure. Allow to penetrate and then buff dry using a soft clean cloth. Previously untreated leather may require additional application.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Gloss - 5 Durability - 7
